items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: she had this little wire-haired terrier named Moochie that someone had just given her the night before.

ctx.x: So I called one back to the phone booth and called up Billie's job and had her to get the doorman to get a cab and come down there and pick us up. That's the only way we'd get up there because they was just taking cabs away from us, you know.

So while I'm making the phone call, she had this little wire-haired terrier named Moochie that someone had just given her the night before. And she had Moochie under her fur coat and this white couple was over in the corner with their backs turned to the streets, you know, facing the bar. Lady and I were in the midst of the bar, facing the bar and they were on the end with their backs turned to the bar. If you can visualize this. And the woman and Billie had a conversation going about dogs. And I got there just…
where I come from, we don't speak to Niggers." I say what did you say? "I said, sir, where we come from we don't speak to Niggers.
